Hello! I like your illustrations and wanted to try and make a request if possible.

Request Details
The request is for a casual outfit design for my OC Vediovis. If it can be similar to this work you did in the past, that would be great.
https://skeb.jp/@ujimoto__/works/21

- Men's fashion or anything boyish is preferred.
- For shoes, cool boots or stylish sneakers might be nice.
- Vediovis' preferred colors are purples, blues and monochrome colors. Any other colors will work well too.
- Regardless of outfit type, please have Vediovis wear gloves. The gloves color and design can be changed as you like depending on the outfit, but simple black gloves are also OK. 
- You are free to change cane design/color.

Character Details
A scientific researcher. She is a serious woman who does not express much emotion usually. She has a unique ability where if she touches any living matter barehanded, it will slowly start to rot. She always wears gloves because of that. 

The pose and expression are up to you.

Please resend if the amount is insufficient for the request. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1i6Y792NO_CFfxqFsoSNZgPIWe-GIG1qN/view?usp=sharing

自キャラ2人で「現パロ」のイラストをお願いできますでしょうか? 参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。

キャラ参照：https://sta.sh/2fyugi847h4

・衣装はご自由に選んでアレンジしても全然構いませんので、かる様のテイストにお任せ致します。

可能ならば、「深夜のゲーセン」のテーマの一枚をお願い致します。うじもと様のレトロ風イラストは全部大好きで、同じ様なカラフルでレトロなモチーフが入れて頂ければ大変嬉しいです。その他は何でも構いませんので、お気軽に描いてください！

依頼内容に何か難しい点か問題点があれば、お気になさらずこの依頼をキャンセルしてください。ご検討のほど、何卒よろしくお願いします。

Nice to meet you, Mr. Ujimoto! I happened to see your illustration on Skeb, and was attracted by the thick and stylish colors, shading, and lively facial expressions you draw.

If you don't mind, I would like to ask you to draw an original character for me and my friend.

The following is an introduction of our characters. (Please refer to the URL below for the appearance of the characters.)

Minato Suzudo
178cm Male
He is a plainclothes police officer. He has a huge sweet tooth and always carries cocoa cigarettes with him. He is always aloof and playful, but his smile disappears when he is serious. He shows no mercy to criminals.
He is an excellent fighter, and fights with strong strength and footwork.

Suoh
170 cm. male
He has a neutral and well-defined face. He is intelligent and has a vast amount of knowledge, but he is not well versed in worldly affairs and has an air of being somewhat out of touch with the world. He is soft-spoken and courteous, but is dry toward all but those he cares about. He is a man who will choose any means to achieve his goals and considers himself a ruthless person, but he is very kind to those whom he has placed in his bosom. However, he has a low tolerance for aggression, and often gets angry or flip-flops when dealing with Suzudo.
He is slender and fights with a gun. He fights with a gun.

Relationships
They met through work. At first, they were just work buddies, hiding their true feelings for each other, but after some twists and turns, they now consider each other to be their "buddy" and "buddy without equal. The words "buddy" and "partner" are more appropriate for this relationship than "friend. They know each other's weaknesses, but they also trust each other, including each other's strength.

Illustrations we would like to request
We would like to have an illustration of two people who wear formal wear and fight as if they are dancing. I would like to see them facing each other in a western-style hall, looking at each other without being able to tell at first glance whether they are dancing or fighting. If it seems too difficult, you can omit the background, etc. ......! I would like to see Suzudo with a serious expression, and Suho with a thin, scowling smile. (Having said that, I really like the colors, shading, and the way you draw, so I hope the above is just a rough reference and you can draw it however you like. ......! I would be happy to leave the clothing, background, specific composition, etc. to you as long as it does not exceed your budget).

Sorry for the length of this long post in your busy schedule: ......! If you don't mind, I would appreciate it if you could give it some thought.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-3APswZcZqASMnpIhrC6JVPvRV0UbieQ

I think your drawings are amazing and I would be honored if you could draw my original character.

The hostel sometimes magically changes its location and appears near climbers seeking spiritual and emotional help. The condor helps them get in touch with their inner self and heal their wounds. Sometimes the condor must fight the evil spirits that haunt the climbers and free them. To do so, he transforms into a beast.

The mountain where he lives is usually snowy, as it is a place where no grass or trees grow at 6,000 meters. I will add some reference images about the hostel so you can get an idea of what it is like.
